#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MODULO = 1000000007;

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

void process_case() {
    int total_points, multiplier;
    cin >> total_points >> multiplier;
    vector<int> sequence(total_points);
    for (int i = 0; i < total_points; ++i) {
        sequence[i] = (multiplier * i) % total_points;
    }

    if (multiplier == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(total_points, total_points - 1, MODULO) << "\n";
        return;
    }

    vector<bool> visited_nodes(total_points, false);
    vector<int> cycle_sizes(total_points, 0);
    long long answer = 1;

    for (int start_node = 0; start_node < total_points; ++start_node) {
        if (visited_nodes[start_node]) continue;
        int cycle_length = 0;
        int node = start_node;
        while (!visited_nodes[node]) {
            visited_nodes[node] = true;
            node = sequence[node];
            ++cycle_length;
        }
        cycle_sizes[cycle_length]++;
    }

    for (int size = 1; size < total_points; ++size) {
        int count = cycle_sizes[size];
        if (count != 0) {
            long long total = (long long)size * count + (size > 1 ? 1 : 0);
            answer = (answer * mod_pow(total, count, MODULO)) % MODULO;
        }
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";
}

int main() {
    int T = 1;
    for (int _ = 0; _ < T; ++_) {
        process_case();
    }
    return 0;
}
